protocol.scope: NFL h2h; research and simulated wagers only
protocol.selection_rule: First eligible bookmaker by fixed priority then lexical key; highest model-EV side, home on ties; strictly above threshold
protocol.selection: No threshold or model selection from evaluated returns; all sensitivity policies reported separately
protocol.promotion: No model changes or real-money transactions

paper_summary.roi_convention: Settled stake includes refunded push/void entries; pending stakes excluded
paper_summary.drawdown_convention: Aggregate equal availability timestamps before equity updates; losing streak ties use game ID; pushes do not reset streak
